name: Pitch Play
description: One sample or many, played chromatically on the pads and from a MIDI keyboard
changelog: 0.1.0: an instrument from one sample or many, picked from a drop-down (saved instruments, the Recorder's takes, the whole card); the pads play it chromatically from a base note, OCT moves it, a MIDI keyboard plays it too; EDIT lists the zones -- add one from the card, remove one, set its root or leave it to detection; SAVE keeps it in /crosspad/pitchplay with its samples copied in; the engine is borrowed from the kits while the app is open (core 1.38 IInstrumentHost); requires core 1.38 and gui 1.18
